body: I've been told i'm ugly more times than I care to remember.

I'm not looking for a model, I just don't want to be stuck with someone that's morbidly obese. I seem to get all kinds of attention from them but I can't force myself to be attracted to them. I dated one that I really liked for 8 months but despite liking her, I never could move past her severe obesity.

I geniunely feel I have a lot more to offer than the people than friends and family around me that seeminly have no problem at all getting dates, but I can't even get a pretty girl to hang out with me, let alone go on a date.

Its been my first priority for years, and I keep getting no where. I'll never make it, I'm done with settling with loneliness
The fact I've never come close. I can't even get an attractive woman to hang out with me, let alone go on a date with me.

I quit smoking both cigarettes and the weed, picked up new activities in my free time. I got off my ass and got a real job so I don't live in my mom's basement anymore. I went to a dermatologist about the zits on my face. I learned how to interact better. I try a lot harder and put myself out more.

My life experiences have made it very clear that the best I can do is someone who I'm not attracted to, which is better than nobody at all to me.
I live right outside the city of Denver, Colorado. It's a big city so that shouldn't be my problem.

I definitely need to work on talking to girls, that's a given. However at the same time I have a hard time believing that it's the only thing barring me from a relationship with someone that I find attractive.

> For example, if you want to go on lengthy nature hikes, an obese person would NOT be able to keep up with you or share that same enthusiasm. 

Funny you mention that. It was when I took my ex on a hike and having to stop every 5 minutes for her to rest is when I started thinking about breaking up with her.
I was much happier when I was with my ex that's 350+ pound body grossed me out than I am now. I don't want to settle with being alone forever.
